build_vitb16_backbone: create a pretrained ViT-B/16 backbone with hooks and configurable readout operations for DPT
build_vitl16_backbone: create a pretrained ViT-L/16 backbone with 1024 features and configurable attention hooks
build_vitb_rn50_backbone: create a pretrained ViT-B/16 + ResNet50 hybrid backbone with optional ViT-only mode
build_deitb16_backbone: create a pretrained DeiT-B/16 backbone with hooks and configurable readout for DPT
run_forward_vit: run forward pass through pretrained ViT backbone to extract four multi-scale feature layers
